hints.title: Dual Container Architecture
hints.text: Maintain an ordered collection for arrival ordering and a lookup collection to verify uniqueness of packet contents.

hints.title: FIFO Eviction Protocol
hints.text: When capacity is reached upon receiving a new unique item, discard the oldest unserved item from memory and remove it from lookup records.

hints.title: Per-Destination Sorted Timestamps
hints.text: Group timestamps by destination and query interval counts using binary bounds.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import deque, defaultdict
import bisect

class Router:
    def __init__(self, memoryLimit: int):
        self.limit = memoryLimit
        self.q = deque()
        self.seen = set()
        self.dest_times = defaultdict(list)

    def addPacket(self, source: int, destination: int, timestamp: int) -> bool:
        pkt = (source, destination, timestamp)
        if pkt in self.seen:
            return False
        if len(self.q) >= self.limit:
            old_src, old_dst, old_ts = self.q.popleft()
            self.seen.remove((old_src, old_dst, old_ts))
            lst = self.dest_times[old_dst]
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(lst, old_ts)
            if idx < len(lst) and lst[idx] == old_ts:
                lst.pop(idx)
        self.q.append(pkt)
        self.seen.add(pkt)
        bisect.insort(self.dest_times[destination], timestamp)
        return True

    def forwardPacket(self) -> list[int]:
        if not self.q:
            return []
        src, dst, ts = self.q.popleft()
        self.seen.remove((src, dst, ts))
        lst = self.dest_times[dst]
        idx = bisect.bisect_left(lst, ts)
        if idx < len(lst) and lst[idx] == ts:
            lst.pop(idx)
        return [src, dst, ts]

    def getCount(self, destination: int, startTime: int, endTime: int) -> int:
        lst = self.dest_times[destination]
        if not lst:
            return 0
        l = bisect.bisect_left(lst, startTime)
        r = bisect.bisect_right(lst, endTime)
        return r - l
```

complexity.time: O(log(N)) per query, O(N) worst-case eviction list adjustment
variables: N: active packets in destination list
complexity.notes: Arrival queue and set provide constant time operations while per-destination ordered lists support logarithmic range counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all packets linearly during getCount takes linear time per query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping timestamps per destination requires duplicated memory for fast counting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle edge cases including duplicate rejection and accurate synchronization across indices.
